result.detail: The model only checks after the first reset edge, because the spec does not define the state before reset. Every acc and sat compare counts as one check, and so does every directed literal check and every corner-coverage check. Failures increment the failed count. The nonce is printed byte by byte with NUL bytes skipped, so no simulator-specific %s padding reaches the verdict line. A watchdog at 10 ms prints the verdict with a failure if the main sequence stalls. Only one verdict line can be printed, guarded by the 'done' flag. The seed can be overridden with +MAC8_SEED=<n>.
